Core API child owned __version__.py, __init__.py, and tests/test_api.py; wrote the real package entry point, waited for fields.py, adapted tests, and reported 91 local tests passing.
Fields child wrote fields.py and tests/test_fields.py, handled lazy marshal and pytz test adjustments, then reported 73 tests passing against the integrated package.
Reqparse child copied and patched reqparse.py/tests; temporarily wrote a stub __init__.py outside its assignment, then observed the real file replace it and reported fields.py as an integration risk.
Inputs child wrote inputs.py/tests, verified direct module behavior in a harness, and reported package-level tests blocked until fields.py landed.
Utilities child wrote utils, cors, crypto, and tests; its CORS checks first hit incomplete package state, then passed 19 tests after Api/Resource and fields landed.
Representations child wrote the representations package and JSON adapter tests, verified 7 tests passing without depending on top-level __init__.py.
Examples child wrote three examples, encountered the temporary stub and import failures, polled for real exports, then verified 18 route checks and cleaned temporary artifacts.
Docs child created docs, templates, static PNGs, themes, and FlaskyStyle, verifying conf.py and theme behavior without sphinx or pygments installed.
Packaging child wrote setup, tox, CI, README, release script, and packaging files; it observed top-level import failures during the temporary stub period and reported them as integration risk.
Parallel parent prepared the reference, launched the nine-child swarm, consumed the aggregate result, ran 327 local tests plus import/example checks, and closed without a submit tool.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent delegated nine distinct module or project-surface assignments through AgentSwarm and retained parent-level integration responsibility after child reports returned.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one actor to copy the upstream package and then patch, verify, and close the project in a single ownership path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel split ownership by component; serial kept implementation and integration in one actor, avoiding concurrent ownership boundaries.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Child briefs included file ownership and global rules, but one reqparse child still wrote a temporary package entry point and other children had to reason around missing or changing exports.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial did not transfer module contracts across child boundaries; it copied the upstream tree and patched interfaces directly when tests exposed issues.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had cross-agent context and import-surface timing problems around `flask_restful.__init__`; serial had ordinary single-agent compatibility work instead.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children individually implemented or adapted core API, fields, reqparse, inputs, utils, representations, examples, docs, and packaging; parent then ran integrated local tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial copied the full upstream 0.3.10 source and tests, added missing theme/script/CI details, patched reqparse, XML, and Api blueprint handling.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel synthesized modules through multiple children; serial used upstream as a base and then patched incompatibilities itself. Both converged to a near-complete implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: All nine subagents completed and returned reports through the AgentSwarm aggregate, after which the parent ran integration checks rather than leaving child work unjoined.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no delegated result lifecycle; each local finding fed directly into the next patch and final verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel required a join and parent consumption step; serial had no child result retrieval boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used a shared workspace where the reqparse child wrote a temporary `__init__.py` and the core child later wrote the real entry point, producing observable import failures for other children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial assembled files sequentially in one workspace owner path and patched files without concurrent child writes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The shared entry-point overwrite/stub episode is the main parallel-only adverse coordination difference.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent reported 327 local tests passing plus import and example checks before closure, and could not find a submit command/tool inside the agent environment.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial final verification showed required imports worked but local pytest retained 4 environment-mismatch failures, with 302 passed and 16 xfailed; it also found no submit command.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel adapted local tests to pass completely; serial left some upstream local tests failing as environment mismatches. The official evaluator still marked both 361/362.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed more time and LLM/tool budget with nine children but completed within budget and closed after parent checks.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used fewer requests and shorter wall time, completed within budget, and closed after its own verification and no-submit check.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent extra coordination budget but not enough to cause a timeout; closure difference is process cost, not official outcome.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations failed at the same aggregate score, 361 of 362, so this is `both_fail`, not a discordant official outcome. Parallel differed by decomposing work across nine children and later integrating; serial differed by copying and patching upstream in a single path. The visible parallel coordination defect caused transient broken-import and polling work for children, but the evidence does not prove it caused the hidden official failure, and serial also failed one official test.
parallel_contributors: Nine-child decomposition increased coordination and shared-state exposure.
Temporary entry-point stub/overwrite caused other parallel children to verify or wait against a broken package API surface.
Parent ultimately ran local integrated checks and reached 327 passing local tests.
serial_contributors: Single actor copied upstream source and patched compatibility issues without child handoffs.
Serial retained local environment-mismatch test failures but still achieved the same official 361/362 result.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel test suite differed from serial: parallel adapted tests to 327 local passes, while serial kept upstream tests with 302 passes, 16 xfails, and 4 local failures.
Artifact file lists differ in docs/tests/examples/support files, but current pair evidence does not reveal which one hidden official test failed.
evaluator_effects: Only aggregate official counts are available inside the allowed pair inputs; no official-result failure name is present in the mounted summaries.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative process explanation with no official outcome differential and no exclusive root-cause claim
